title: Refresh active relinks same account

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Active local refresh must overwrite the matched saved snapshot with current live auth only when the current live identity resolves to the same saved account and the auth fingerprint changed.
Active local refresh must not overwrite saved snapshots when the current live identity is ambiguous or does not match a saved account.

targetSurface: CodexPill active refresh use-case and identity matcher fixtures

nonClaims: Does not execute a live Codex app-server.
Does not use real auth snapshots, tokens, account identifiers, emails, hostnames, or private paths.
Does not prove remote install or switch preflight relink.
Does not prove menu projection or live macOS menu-bar behavior.
